Reference tables

Source: R/reference.R
parl_reference.Rd

The tables used to identify speakers and assign parties, as published in the DADES/ and FONTS_I_REVISIO/ folders of the dataset. They are bundled with the package and need no download. Their columns are described in the codebook.

Usage

parl_mps()

parl_parties()

parl_parties_by_year()

parl_governments()

parl_ministers()

parl_offices()

parl_party_changes()

parl_chairs()

parl_aliases()

parl_review_cases()

Value

A tibble.

Details

  • parl_mps(): the 83 MPs elected in 1932 (diputats.csv).

  • parl_parties(): party acronyms (partits.csv).

  • parl_parties_by_year(): MPs and government status per year and party (partits_per_any.csv).

  • parl_governments(): governments of the Generalitat and their parties (governs.csv).

  • parl_ministers(): the ministers (consellers) of each government, one row per minister and government (governs_consellers.csv). nom_sencer is filled only for people who appear in the corpus.

  • parl_offices(): holders of the offices that speak in the Diari (carrecs.csv). carrec is a harmonised label; variants_capcalera holds the heading forms matched against the carrec column of parl_speeches().

Columns with several values (partits, anys_amb_diputats, anys_al_govern, governs, claus_orador, variants_capcalera) separate them with "|".

  • parl_party_changes(): dated party changes (canvis_partit.csv).

  • parl_chairs(): who chairs each session and from which speech (presidencia_sessions.csv).

  • parl_aliases(): speaker headings resolved by hand (alias_oradors.csv).

  • parl_review_cases(): doubtful cases and the decisions taken (review_cases.csv).
